content.jointProblem: Determine the root cause of weld-joint cracking in mild-steel hollow-section conveyor frames operating at 2–6 °C under vibration plus thermal cycling and condensation, and test whether changes to welding procedure, filler material or crossmember-to-stringer joint design reduce crack driving force and extend fatigue life.

rationale.text: Erić’s group directly studies fatigue and fracture of welded structural steel joints under combined cyclic mechanical loading and low-temperature thermal excursions.

sources.quote: His research group focuses on fatigue and fracture mechanics of welded structural steel joints subjected to combined cyclic mechanical loading and low-temperature thermal excursions

rationale.text: The group has the relevant low-temperature fatigue testing infrastructure, including servo-hydraulic machines and a climate chamber down to −60 °C.

sources.quote: The group routinely uses servo-hydraulic fatigue testing machines, a climate chamber capable of reaching −60 °C, and in-house FE models built in Abaqus

rationale.text: Erić has published on superimposed thermal cycling during mechanical fatigue, which matches AutomVoj’s suspected thermal-cycling plus vibration mechanism.

sources.quote: This work examined whether superimposed thermal cycling (between −30 °C and +20 °C at 0.5 cycles per hour) during mechanical fatigue loading alters crack initiation and growth behaviour

rationale.text: His residual-stress work is relevant to changing welding procedure or post-weld treatment to reduce weld-toe crack driving force.

sources.quote: The study quantified how PWHT redistribution of residual stress affected predicted fatigue lives using a linear-elastic fracture-mechanics assessment

rationale.text: He is explicitly open to contract research on fatigue and fracture testing of welded steel components and to joint projects on low-temperature or combined loading fatigue testing.

sources.quote: contract research on fatigue and fracture testing of welded steel components
joint projects involving fatigue testing under low-temperature or combined loading conditions

rationale.text: A prior project combined sub-zero fatigue testing, residual-stress measurement, digital image correlation and FE simulation, which is close to the workflow AutomVoj needs.

sources.quote: The work combined fatigue testing at controlled sub-zero temperatures, X-ray diffraction residual stress measurements, digital image correlation, and sequentially coupled FE simulations.

constraints.text: The company lacks low-temperature cyclic-load test capability, so the academic partner must provide the climate-chamber and servo-hydraulic testing route.

sources.quote: We do not currently have the equipment or know-how to test at low temperatures under cyclic load.

constraints.text: The test programme must represent service conditions: 2–6 °C operation with thermal cycling, condensation and loaded-belt vibration, not only room-temperature load.

sources.quote: the combination of thermal cycling, condensation, and the vibration load from loaded belts

constraints.text: Access to the failed sections and site evidence is required; the company has photos, measurements and two failed sections in storage.

sources.quote: We have photos and measurements of the cracked joints from site visits
we still have two of the failed sections in storage

constraints.text: Specimens must match the production detail: mild-steel hollow section, MIG/MAG welded crossmember-to-stringer joint, painted for corrosion resistance.

sources.quote: Our conveyor frames are welded from mild steel hollow section and painted for corrosion resistance before delivery.
Mild steel and stainless steel MIG/MAG welded frame fabrication

constraints.text: Erić’s climate chamber and servo-hydraulic machine are shared, so an extended test campaign needs advance scheduling.

sources.quote: Erić's climate chamber and servo-hydraulic machine are shared with two other research groups; scheduling access for extended test campaigns requires advance coordination.

constraints.text: AutomVoj has no dedicated R&D department, so the project needs a named engineering owner and allocated company time rather than informal project work.

sources.quote: We have no dedicated R&D department; technical development happens informally through project work
